title: How Banks Create Money

segments.say: Most of the money in a modern economy is not notes or coins. It is numbers in bank accounts.

anim.below: of UK broad money is bank deposits (Bank of England, 2014)

segments.say: The Bank of England found that bank deposits made up ninety-seven per cent of the broad money in Britain.

anim.title: A loan makes a deposit
items: A new deposit, and new money, exists

segments.say: Where do those deposits come from? Largely from lending. When a bank makes a loan, it credits the borrower's account, and new money is created.

anim.title: The brake
items: Banks must keep part of deposits as reserves
Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR), set by RBI

segments.say: There is a brake. Banks must keep a share of their deposits as cash reserves. In India, the Reserve Bank sets this cash reserve ratio.
Take NCERT's example. With a reserve ratio of twenty per cent, a hundred rupees deposited lets eighty be lent. That eighty comes back as a deposit, and the chain goes on, smaller each round.
Add up every round, and a hundred rupees can support up to five hundred in deposits. The multiplier is one divided by the reserve ratio.
For GS Three: raise the reserve ratio and banks can lend less, so money grows more slowly. That is one way RBI controls money supply.

sources: NCERT Class 12, Introductory Macroeconomics, ch. 3 (Money and Banking): money comprises cash and bank deposits; banks accept deposits and lend part of them; Cash Reserve Ratio is the percentage of deposits a bank must keep as cash reserves; example with CRR 20% and deposits of Rs 100 (table of rounds 100, 80, 64…; loans cannot exceed Rs 400); RBI controls money supply through bank rate, open market operations and reserve ratios

Bank of England Quarterly Bulletin 2014 Q1, 'Money creation in the modern economy': most money is created by commercial banks making loans; whenever a bank makes a loan it simultaneously creates a matching deposit, creating new money; bank deposits are about 97% of broad money in circulation (UK)

quiz.q: With a Cash Reserve Ratio of 20%, what is the money multiplier?
According to the Bank of England, when a bank makes a loan it…
options: Creates a matching deposit, which is new money

quiz.q: If RBI raises the CRR, banks can…
quiz.why: More must be held as reserves, so less can be lent.
